title: 📱 New Reports on iPhone 18!
body: Korean reports revealed that the screens for iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 will soon enter mass production, ahead of their launch in March 2027.
Samsung will start producing the screens in January, and LG before the end of this year, and Samsung will be the sole supplier of screens for iPhone Air 2.
Simply put, Apple has split its phone launches: the Pro models in September, and the standard model and Air in the spring.
Are you waiting for iPhone 18? Or will you buy the Pro version now?
